title: Trouble navigating to and from TabContainer with "ui_up" and "ui_down"
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] and earlier

### System information

Windows 11 - AMD Radeon RX 7900XTX

### Issue description

I've set the focus_neighbors on my tabs and respective buttons to get to the tabs, but the focus isn't being grabbed correctly.  When I'm on a tab and I press "ui_down", I lose focus of everything, and when I hit "ui_up", "ui_right", or "ui_left", nothing happens.  If I hit "ui_down" again, I grab the focus of what I wanted to grab originally.  This is not user friendly, making them hit the button twice.

The more pressing issue is getting back to the tab.  When you are not focused on a TabBar and want to get back to the tab with "ui_up", the window will lose focus completely until "ui_down" is pressed again.  I can only get to and from 

the tabs using "ui_focus_previous" and "ui_focus_next" keybinds, but again, they must be pressed twice.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d89c87ac-613a-4ff9-ad2b-832b7a04527a

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce, start the scene and use the keyboard arrows or a controller to navigate through the menu.  You won't be able to get to the tabs.  If you click on a tab with your mouse to grab focus, you can navigate between each tab with no problem, but once "ui_down" is pressed, you will lose focus and not grab the button you expect.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[TabContainerUIDownRepro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19738868/TabContainerUIDownRepro.zip)
